# s212 — Find items by exact title

Provide deterministic title equality for client-side dedupe while retaining ordinary substring search.

**Findings:** agents feedback 2026-10-05 U4c; docs/feedback/agents-2026-10-05.md · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** making titles unique, fuzzy search changes, key-based filing, or title normalization.

## Why

U4's workaround filters find results in a script. cmd_find currently casefolds and substring-matches fields. Exact matching is a small independent read-only capability.

## Files

CLI find parser/handler, find tests, command and agent references, and CHANGELOG.md.

## Failing tests

- Exact mode returns a case-sensitive equal stored title; a superstring, different case, different Unicode normalization, and short-title-only match are excluded.
- Multiple identical stored titles return all matches in normal stable find order; done/retired inclusion follows existing find behavior.
- No match succeeds with the usual empty-result text and JSON shape.
- Exact mode combined with a positional substring query or --in fails as usage. Existing positional find behavior and output contracts are unchanged.

## Implement

Add title-exact with its own TITLE argument, mutually exclusive with the positional query and field-selector --in. Require exactly one search mode. Compare the stored full title with Python string equality, not display_title, casefold, or Unicode normalization. Return the normal find envelope and mark title as the matching field. Update examples and help without changing storage.
